hypothesis: W-R51's three training cohorts show batch learning lacks cross-family reliability when developed solely on affine-prior data. Under exactly the same finite 1728-signed-example budget and order-invariant full-batch update, a fixed balanced split of three generator families may improve minimum-family heldout performance, but could harm established source families. Test on three independently preregistered development cohorts without selecting the best.
freeze: Before any first use freeze development blocks3424..3439,3456..3471,3488..3503 and fresh sealed heldout3520..3567, both four-bit XOR55/identity, two original/altered presentation directions and three synthetic generator families/two heldout swap sites. Two arms on each block: affine_only development9 entities, mixed_three_sources exactly 3 seed-rotated entities per family across three families, 16-weight no-bias, 32 full-batch epochs LR0.1/1728. All arms see exactly1728 signed paired examples; update counts, training corpus SHA, model weight SHA preserved. Do not alter training samples, weights or decision gates after outcomes.
classification: FAMILY_DIVERSITY_ROBUST iff in ALL THREE development blocks mixed-source model improves the minimum heldout generator accuracy over affine-only by >=0.05, no individual source decreases by more than 0.05, AND balanced overall score>=0.55. PARTIAL_FAMILY_GAIN iff at least two of three blocks show minimum-family improvement>=0.02 without regard to stricter overall constraints. NO_CONFIRMED_DIVERSITY_GAIN otherwise. Report all arm per-seed/family results, including worsening cases.
controls: Fixed source generation rules and lag2 XOR-invariant features inherited from W-R47/W-R50. Mixed arm alters generator and entity exposure by design; neither equal-compute nor causally isolated pure-family identity is claimed beyond equal sample size and batch epochs.
All model parameters frozen before the one sealed heldout used across six trained arms. Three dev blocks are NOT three independent heldout experiments.
Report identity/XOR55 exact invariance, 16 weights, all presentation orientations balanced, tie half-credit and exact per-source class composition.
Immutable original first-use archive and one full Go regression/build; no accepted refs, production or orchestration changes.
claim_limit: Synthetic two-candidate source-family balanced batch training at equal labeled-example counts, not natural environment transfer or autonomous recurrent cognition.
